overall_assessment: NTNU section splitting is mostly sound: course_content, learning_outcomes (all Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse groups survive) and coursework_requirements are correct, and the 14 suspects are mostly false alarms (the 'boilerplate' flag fires because the same PPU course is offered in several years with identical text). Real defects are in assessment (raw JavaScript, exam-logistics tables, duplicated blocks, coursework filed as assessment) and in teaching_methods, which absorbs assessment rules or attendance requirements that sit under neighbouring headings.

findings.evidence: function toggleRooms(target) { const examRoomsDiv =  const examRoomsButton = examRoomsDiv.find("button"); const roomListDivs = examRoomsDiv.find("div.room-list");
findings.description: Every PPU course with an exam table ends its assessment text with a raw inline JavaScript function from the NTNU exam-rooms widget. It is pure page cruft and pollutes otherwise correct assessment text. 11 of the 14 suspects show it.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The 'Mer om vurdering' / exam block is extracted with text() including <script> content; there is no script/style removal for the NTNU selector or in .clean_sections().
findings.suggested_fix: Remove <script>/<style> nodes before text extraction for ntnu (pre_fn in institution_config.R), or drop lines starting with 'function toggleRooms' in .clean_sections().

findings.evidence: Karakter Bokstavkarakterer Vekting 100/100 Dato Utlevering  Innlevering  Tid Utlevering  Innlevering  Varighet 8 timer Eksamenssystem Inspera Assessment
findings.description: Assessment is dominated by the exam-schedule table (Ordinær/Utsatt eksamen rows with date/time/room/duration/exam-system placeholders), which the rubric lists as exam logistics that should not be in assessment. The useful parts (weights such as 2/3 + 1/3, form: hjemmeeksamen, FoU-rapport) are buried in logistics. The table rows with empty Dato/Tid fields carry no information.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The whole exam widget under 'Mer om vurdering' / Vurdering is taken verbatim as assessment text; no logistics stripping.
findings.suggested_fix: In an ntnu post-processor, drop table-row lines matching '^Karakter .* (Vekting|Varighet|Dato|Sted og rom|Eksamenssystem)' tokens like 'Dato', 'Tid', 'Sted og rom', 'Eksamenssystem Inspera Assessment', or reduce each exam block to form + Vekting only.

findings.description: In the 2014/2015 PPU4725/PPU4729 plans, the exam blocks appear twice in assessment (the 'Skriftlig' 100/100 block and the Rapport 1/3 + Skriftlig eksamen 2/3 block are each repeated back to back), since the page lists the same table for two Vurderingsordning variants.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The page contains two renderings of the exam table (one per ordning variant) and the extractor concatenates both; the full plan text itself is not asked to dedupe.
findings.suggested_fix: Deduplicate consecutive identical exam blocks (split on 'Ordinær eksamen -' / 'Utsatt eksamen -' and keep unique blocks) in .clean_sections() for ntnu assessment.

findings.evidence: Vurderingsbesvarelsen kan skrives på norsk, svensk eller dansk. En student som ikke har bestått i emnet på grunn av stryk i en av delvurderingene behøver bare framstille seg til ny vurdering
findings.description: In the older PPU47xx plans (2014-2016) the assessment rules (answer language, resit of failed parts, appeal of grades, 'For deltajert beskrivelse av vurderingen...') follow the Læringsformer text with no 'Mer om vurdering' heading, so they are appended to teaching_methods. They belong in assessment, while assessment holds only the exam table. The codebook says teaching_methods is how teaching is done, not exam rules. Two sections end up merged and assessment is incomplete.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Older NTNU page layout has no 'Mer om vurdering' heading; the heading map therefore has nothing to cut at, and the text falls under 'Læringsformer og aktiviteter'.
findings.suggested_fix: In ntnu post-processing, move paragraphs of teaching_methods starting with 'For deltajert/detaljert beskrivelse av vurderingen' or 'Vurderingsbesvarelsen' (and everything after) into assessment.

findings.evidence: Det kreves derfor 75 % oppmøte for å kunne fremstille seg til eksamen i faget. Det er avgjørende at studentene utvikler seg til selvstendige og ansvarlige lærere
findings.description: The newer PPU46xx teaching_methods ends with the NTNU certification paragraph stating the 75 % attendance requirement and that all obligatoriske aktiviteter must be approved. This is a pass/approve gate, which the codebook places in coursework_requirements (that section only holds the short bullet list), and the paragraph is also partly institutional boilerplate. It appears in every PPU46xx course of the sample.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The paragraph sits under 'Læringsformer og aktiviteter' in the NTNU page, so the heading-based split assigns it to teaching_methods.
findings.suggested_fix: Split off the paragraph starting 'NTNU er tillagt et sertifiseringsansvar' from teaching_methods and append it to coursework_requirements (or drop it as boilerplate).

- Deltakelse på tre seminar

findings.description: Under 'Mer om vurdering' NTNU lists the compulsory assignments; these are filed as assessment as well as (duplicating) coursework_requirements. In LÆR2003 the whole assessment is only 'Det vil bli gitt inntil seks obligatoriske arbeidskrav...', i.e. no graded assessment at all; in EDU2001 'Compulsory assignments' (international field course) is under assessment. The codebook says arbeidskrav belong in coursework_requirements.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Mer om vurdering' is mapped wholesale to assessment, and its 'Obligatoriske arbeidskrav'/'Compulsory assignments' sub-block is not split off.
findings.suggested_fix: Within the ntnu 'Mer om vurdering' block, split off sub-blocks headed 'Obligatoriske arbeidskrav' / 'Compulsory assignments' into coursework_requirements.

findings.description: reading_list is emitted as the placeholder 'Oppgis senere.' (to be announced) in all PPU47xx courses of 2014-2016, so the row exists but holds no reading list. This is the pre-pass 'empty' flag and is a real placeholder.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Kursmateriell is mapped to reading_list correctly, but .clean_sections() does not treat short placeholders as empty.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() drop sections whose text matches '^(Oppgis senere|Ingen|-)\.?$' (case-insensitive).

findings.evidence: Opptak til femårig lærerutdanning og beståtte eksamener i henhold til forskrift.
findings.description: Prerequisites for most PPU courses consists only of programme admission wording ('Opptak til femårig lærerutdanning...', 'Som opptakskrav til studieprogrammet, se studiets studieplan.', 'Forkunnskapskravet må være innfridd'). These are admission/study-plan statements, not prior knowledge. Some, like 'Beståtte eksamener i henhold til studieplanen', are borderline.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Forkunnskapskrav heading is mapped directly to prerequisites without an admission-text filter.
findings.suggested_fix: Blank prerequisites that match known NTNU admission boilerplate ('Opptak til ...', 'Som opptakskrav til studieprogrammet', 'Forkunnskapskravet må være innfridd').
